value.rationale: The puncture of the canonical minimum reveals topology that global contractibility hides. Prime-generated coordinate subgroups are intrinsic to the published join-factorization structure, not arbitrary slices. In every rank the exact sphere type, full homeomorphism group and integral signed orientation are determined; the natural global inverse produces projective-space two-torsion in rank three and above, while the infinite-rank puncture becomes weakly trivial. This is an exact structural classification of a naturally introduced topological group-poset, with applications to its symmetry and quotient topology.
